description: Open-access ESG encyclopedia by Ascent Partners Foundation (350+ articles in English, Chinese and Hindi) with a public REST API and an MCP server that lets AI agents search and read ESG, sustainability and climate content.
rules: The public REST API base is https://esg-hub.ascent.partners/api/v1 (no auth): /pages, /search?q=..., /resources, /meta.

The MCP server in mcp-server/ exposes 12 tools: 10 read-only (search_esg, search_content, get_esg_page, list_esg_pages, list_esg_resources, get_esg_metadata, get_term, get_related, list_frameworks, list_industries) and 2 write tools (propose_term, tag_content) that need ESG_HUB_WRITE_TOKEN.
Paginate list tools with the returned `structuredContent.pagination.next_offset`.
Cite the article permalink returned by get_esg_page when quoting ESG Hub content.
